_comment: UTAH STATE LEGISLATURE — the curator's bill selection for the 2024 General Session, and the issue mapping for each. Same doctrine as db/vr-utah-bills.json, which covers 2025GS: read by scripts/vr-utah-ingest.mjs, which decides none of it; every entry was selected by hand; every mapping names the provision it reads. A bill is here because a contested recorded floor vote on it separates one legislator from another AND its operative provisions point one way on an issue the app already has a key for. No key was invented for this session. HOW THE CANDIDATE LIST WAS BUILT: `vr-utah-ingest.mjs --survey --session 2024GS` read the legislature's own passed-bills index (552 bills), walked every bill's action table, and applied the same one-final-passage-per-chamber and 10% minority-share rules the ingest applies later. It reported 125 admissible contested roll calls across 103 bills. Forty of those 103 were read in full; 28 are admitted below and 12 are refused with reasons. The other 63 contested bills were not reviewed in this wave — that is a coverage gap, not a judgement about them, and it is recorded here so the selection cannot read as 'all the contested bills there were'.

measures.title: Sex-based Designations for Privacy, Anti-bullying, and Women's Opportunities
measures.generalProvisions: This bill establishes a standard regarding distinctions on the basis of sex and applies the standard in certain facilities and opportunities where designations on the basis of sex address individual privacy, bullying, and women's opportunities.

issues.rationale: The bill defines sex for the entire Utah Code, restricts sex-designated restroom, shower and locker room facilities in the public education system and in publicly owned or controlled buildings to the designated sex, and adds components to the crimes of voyeurism and criminal trespass for entering a covered facility. Transgender access to public facilities is the operative subject, and a yea is a vote to restrict it.

The bill's own general provisions name individual privacy as the interest being protected, and it requires government entities to adopt privacy compliance plans and to provide a single-occupant facility in new construction. Secondary because those duties are the bill's mechanism, not its disputed subject.

measures.title: Equal Opportunity Initiatives
measures.generalProvisions: This bill prohibits an institution of higher education, the public education system, and a governmental employer from taking certain actions and engaging in discriminatory practices.

issues.rationale: The bill prohibits institutions of higher education, the public education system and governmental employers from requiring diversity submissions or training that promotes differential treatment, from using protected characteristics in employment or admissions decisions, and from maintaining an office that engages in those practices. Dismantling diversity, equity and inclusion offices is the whole bill, so a yea is a vote for it.

measures.title: Utah Constitutional Sovereignty Act
measures.generalProvisions: This bill enacts the Utah Constitutional Sovereignty Act.

issues.rationale: The bill enacts the Utah Constitutional Sovereignty Act, which establishes a framework for the Legislature to prohibit state officers from enforcing a federal directive it determines violates state sovereignty. Asserting state authority against federal directives is the entire operative content.

measures.title: Utah Fits All Scholarship Program Amendments
measures.generalProvisions: This bill amends provisions regarding the Utah Fits All Scholarship Program.

issues.rationale: The bill amends the Utah Fits All Scholarship Program: it extends eligibility to children of military service members and to adopting foster parents, opens local education agency participation to home-based scholarship students, and moves administration of appeals and cost-effectiveness review. Every operative provision widens or entrenches the state's education voucher programme.

measures.title: Alternative Education Scholarship Combination
measures.generalProvisions: This bill combines the Carson Smith Scholarship and Special Needs Opportunity Scholarship Programs.

issues.rationale: The bill merges the Carson Smith and Special Needs Opportunity scholarship programmes, extends eligibility to home-school and preschool-aged students, adds qualifying-provider expenses to allowable uses, and grants regulatory autonomy to qualifying schools and providers. It expands publicly funded private-education scholarships and reduces oversight of the providers.

measures.title: School Employee Firearm Possession Amendments
measures.generalProvisions: This bill creates a program regarding the possession of a firearm by a school employee.

issues.rationale: The bill creates the Educator-Protector Program, which incentivises school teachers to secure or carry a firearm on school grounds. It expands where and by whom firearms may be carried, and a yea is a vote for that expansion.

measures.title: Social Media Regulation Amendments
measures.generalProvisions: This bill enacts provisions related to age assurance and protecting minors in the Utah Minor Protection in Social Media Act (Act).

issues.rationale: The bill requires social media companies to verify a new account holder's age through an approved system, to enable maximum default privacy settings on Utah minor accounts, to provide supervisory and verifiable parental consent tools, and to protect the confidentiality of minors' data, with Division of Consumer Protection enforcement behind it. The disputed question was how far the state may go in mandating data practices on behalf of minors.

measures.title: State Energy Policy Amendments
measures.generalProvisions: This bill modifies the state energy policy.

issues.rationale: The bill rewrites the state energy policy to encourage the use of dispatchable energy resources, to focus the policy on human well-being and quality of life, and to require the Office of Energy Development to report on the state energy plan's compliance with it. 'Dispatchable' is the bill's own operative word and it points at thermal generation, so a yea is a vote to steer state policy toward conventional production.

measures.title: Home Solar Energy Amendments
measures.generalProvisions: This bill modifies provisions related to the Residential Solar Energy Disclosure Act.

issues.rationale: The bill amends the Residential Solar Energy Disclosure Act to require a solar retailer to hand the customer a signed copy of the agreement, forbids beginning installation until four business days later, gives the customer a four-day cancellation window, and adds Division of Consumer Protection enforcement and court action. The subject is what a seller owes a household, not whether solar is built.

measures.title: Energy Independence Amendments
measures.generalProvisions: This bill modifies provisions related to planning and cost recovery for certain energy resource decisions and allows a large-scale electric utility to establish a Utah fire fund.

issues.rationale: The bill changes the factors the Public Service Commission must weigh in evaluating energy resource decisions, sets terms for a utility's recovery of costs for proven dispatchable generation located within the state, and encourages the commission to evaluate buying excess dispatchable capacity. It puts a thumb on the scale for in-state conventional generation.

measures.title: Energy Security Amendments
measures.generalProvisions: This bill modifies provisions related to the regulation of energy.

issues.rationale: The bill lets the state buy an electrical generation facility that is slated for decommissioning, creates a Decommissioned Asset Disposition Authority to run it, and creates an alternative air permit track for project entities. It exists to keep generating plants operating past the point their owners would retire them.

measures.title: Water Efficient Landscaping Requirements
measures.generalProvisions: This bill addresses use of overhead spray irrigation.

issues.rationale: The bill restricts the use of overhead spray irrigation by certain governmental entities. It is a single-subject conservation mandate on public landscaping, so a yea is a vote for state action on water use.

measures.title: Housing and Transit Reinvestment Zone Amendments
measures.generalProvisions: This bill amends provisions related to housing and transit reinvestment zones.

issues.rationale: The bill requires that 12% of proposed dwelling units in a housing and transit reinvestment zone be reserved for specified income levels, that the affordability requirement be met in each phase of development, and that a zone be at least ten acres, while clarifying tax-increment notice and capture. It tightens the affordability terms on which the zones get public financing.

A housing and transit reinvestment zone is defined around transit infrastructure, and the bill amends how sales and use tax increment inside it is captured. Secondary because the amendments themselves are about housing terms rather than transit service.

measures.title: First Home Investment Zone Act
measures.generalProvisions: This bill enacts the First Home Investment Zone Act.

issues.rationale: The bill enacts the First Home Investment Zone Act, which lets a municipality create a zone that captures tax increment to finance affordable owner-occupied housing and sets requirements for density, affordability and development size. Increasing opportunities for home ownership is named in the bill's own list of objectives.
The density and mixed-use requirements and the tax-increment financing are supply-side: they pay for units to be built. Secondary because the Act's stated target is first purchase specifically.

measures.title: Child Care Revisions
measures.generalProvisions: This bill modifies provisions related to caring for children.

issues.rationale: The bill makes the Department of Health and Human Services certificate optional for residential child care, caps the number of under-threes an unlicensed home provider may take, requires criminal history checks of providers operating without a licence or certificate, and raises the age of a dependent for whom a child tax credit may be claimed. Its purpose is to enlarge the supply of home-based child care, and a yea is a vote for that trade of licensing for supply.

measures.title: Child Care Grant Amendments
measures.generalProvisions: This bill modifies provisions related to child care subsidy.

issues.rationale: The bill authorises the Office of Child Care to award a full child care subsidy or grant to a child with at least one parent working full-time at a child care provider. It is a single-subject subsidy aimed at staffing the sector.

measures.title: Market Informed Compensation for Teachers
measures.generalProvisions: This bill amends and creates programs to enhance teacher salary supplement opportunities.

issues.rationale: The bill repeals and reenacts the Teacher Salary Supplement Program as a supplement for highly needed educators, creates an Excellence in Education and Leadership Supplement with eligibility criteria assessed by each local education agency and validated by the Center for the School of the Future, and directs the State Board of Education to disburse the funds. It is about how the state pays public school teachers.

measures.title: Drug Sentencing Modifications
measures.generalProvisions: This bill addresses the sentencing for an individual convicted of distributing illegal drugs in certain circumstances.

issues.rationale: The bill requires a court, with limited exceptions, to sentence a person convicted of distributing drugs to an indeterminate prison term where the person had a dangerous weapon readily accessible or distributed or possessed a firearm with intent to distribute. It removes judicial discretion in favour of prison, which is what this key names.

measures.title: Sentencing Modifications for Certain DUI Offenses
measures.generalProvisions: This bill modifies provisions related to negligently operating a vehicle resulting in death and who may become an ignition interlock restricted driver.

issues.rationale: The bill renames the offence of negligently operating a vehicle resulting in death, creates a sentencing guideline for automobile homicide, and modifies impound fees and ignition-interlock election. The operative change is a sentencing guideline for a homicide offence.

measures.title: Drug Paraphernalia Amendments
measures.generalProvisions: This bill concerns possession of certain types of drug paraphernalia.

issues.rationale: The bill provides for the dismissal of a charge of possession of certain drug paraphernalia under specified conditions and sets the burden of proof for that dismissal. It narrows the reach of a possession offence, which is the reform direction of this key.

measures.title: Public Lands Possession Amendments
measures.generalProvisions: This bill asserts ownership and exclusive jurisdiction of roads included on a county travel plan and requires due process before the federal government may close a road.

issues.rationale: The bill asserts state and county ownership and jurisdiction over roads on a county's class B and class D road map or travel plan unless closed through proper adjudicative proceedings, lets the state or a county disregard an attempted closure without due process, and places the burden of proof on the federal government. It is a claim of local control over land access.
The burden-shifting clause is directed at the federal government by name. Secondary because the bill's subject is county roads rather than federal authority generally.

measures.title: Income Tax Amendments
measures.generalProvisions: This bill modifies income tax provisions.

issues.rationale: The bill amends the corporate franchise and income tax rates and the individual income tax rate. It is a rate bill and nothing else; the 2024 session's rate change was a cut.

measures.title: Federal Law Enforcement Amendments
measures.generalProvisions: This bill concerns the release of an alien within the state by a federal officer.

issues.rationale: The bill requires a federal officer to follow specified procedures before releasing an alien within the state. It is a single-subject immigration-enforcement bill directed at federal release practices.

measures.title: Public School History Curricula Amendments
measures.generalProvisions: This bill adds the "Ten Commandments" and the Magna Carta to a list of historical documents and principles that school curricula and activities may include for a thorough study.

issues.rationale: The bill adds the Ten Commandments and the Magna Carta to the list of historical documents and principles that school curricula and activities may include for a thorough study. The contested addition is a religious text, and a yea is a vote to name it in statute.
The list the bill amends governs what public school curricula may include. Secondary because the bill grants no parental right and changes no consent requirement.

measures.title: Student Survey Amendments
measures.generalProvisions: This bill amends student survey requirements.

issues.rationale: The bill removes references to the statewide student health and risk prevention survey, requires annual written parental consent for certain student surveys and new consent for a transferring student, requires that parents be given the list of recipients of collected data, and forbids rewards or consequences tied to participation. Parental control over what a school asks a child is the whole subject.

measures.title: Criminal Defamation Amendments
measures.generalProvisions: This bill repeals the offense of criminal defamation.

issues.rationale: The bill repeals the offence of criminal defamation. Removing a speech crime from the code is a single-subject speech question.

measures.title: Public Health Amendments
measures.generalProvisions: This bill amends provisions related to public health.

issues.rationale: The bill narrows when the Department of Health and Human Services and a local health department may invoke an order of restriction, and repeals the exception that let institutions of higher education impose vaccination and face covering requirements on medical students. Both provisions cut public health authority over individuals.

measures.title: Capital City Revitalization Zone
measures.generalProvisions: This bill enacts provisions to enable a local government to create a revitalization zone.

issues.rationale: The bill establishes procedures for a qualifying local government to create a capital city revitalization zone, authorises a sales and use tax within its boundaries for use in the project area, and provides for a project participation agreement letting a private participant share in the funds collected. It is a publicly financed development district, and the disagreement was over the subsidy.

measures.title: Precious Metals Amendments
measures.generalProvisions: This bill modifies provisions related to precious metals.

issues.rationale: Enrolled text exempts a portion of the funds in certain budget reserve accounts from the State Money Management Act, authorizes the state treasurer to invest a portion of those reserve funds in precious metals, and requires the treasurer to conduct a precious-metals study. Taking part of the state's reserves out of the ordinary money-management rules in order to buy bullion is the whole bill, so a yea is a vote for the state holding metal.
